headline: FATF Removes Ivory Coast from Money-Laundering Grey List
summary: The Financial Action Task Force has removed Ivory Coast from its grey list after two years, potentially easing compliance constraints and extra checks for international banks.
why: FATF delisting lowers transaction costs, enhances foreign direct investment, and eases correspondent banking relations.

impacts.name: Ivory Coast
impacts.why: Removal from the FATF grey list reduces international banking scrutiny.
